subject.title: feat(ios): read-only workspace Files browser on the Agents surface

question: Should this iOS Files browser remain blocked until the stacked gateway RPC PR lands with an approved workspace file-read authorization boundary?
rationale: The client patch is repairable, but it exposes browse, preview, and share UI for arbitrary workspace file content, so merge timing depends on the server-side security decision in the stacked gateway PR.

options.title: Wait For Approved Gateway Scope
options.body: Keep this branch stacked or paused until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100738 lands with the approved authorization boundary, then fix navigation and i18n before retargeting to main.

options.title: Accept Current Read-Scope Surface
options.body: Proceed only if security owners explicitly accept that the mobile app may preview and share workspace files through the current read-scope RPC design.

options.title: Pause Mobile Client Work
options.body: Hold the iOS and Android client branches until the broader workspace-management direction settles across the related API issues and PRs.

recommendation.title: Wait For Approved Gateway Scope
recommendation.body: Keep this branch stacked or paused until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100738 lands with the approved authorization boundary, then fix navigation and i18n before retargeting to main.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected feature issue and authored the stacked iOS and gateway/mobile work, making them the clearest owner to route the scope and merge-timing decision.
